terms: kicknap is a marketplace that connects guests with hosts for hourly stays — short bookings of a space during the workday.
The platform is operated by Learnix (KvK 42119992), Amsterdam, Netherlands.
Hosts set the price they receive. Guests pay one all-in total, which includes kicknap's 16% service fee and any applicable charges.
A booking is confirmed when it is created and the space is free. Payment is processed at checkout through our payment provider.

Guests can cancel a booking for free up to 24 hours before it starts and receive the full paid amount back — kicknap does not keep its service fee on cancellations. Within 24 hours of the start time cancellations are no longer possible, and once a booking has started it can no longer be cancelled.
Hosts receive payouts for completed, paid bookings. Payout details are shown in the host dashboard.
kicknap is an early-stage service: availability and bookings are provided as-is, and we are not liable for issues beyond our reasonable control.
Guests and hosts are each responsible for lawful use of the platform and of the spaces.
We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use after changes means you accept them. Questions: hello@kicknap.com.
privacy: We collect only what we need: account email and name, booking details, and payment status.
We use this to power bookings, send confirmations, and show your bookings and earnings.
Payments are handled by Stripe; we never store card details.
We use cookies only for login sessions.
Under the GDPR you may access, correct, or delete your data. Contact hello@kicknap.com to exercise these rights.
Data is stored on EU-hosted infrastructure and kept while your account is active, plus as long as legally required.
